name: 4-seater garden lounge set with wood effect
material: Nylon-look webbing fabric w/t heat transfer steel frame. w/t polyester fabric cushion
description: Give your outdoor space a touch of natural charm with this low 4-seater wood-effect garden lounge set, ideal for creating a cozy and welcoming corner with ease!  Comprising a two-seater sofa, two armchairs, and a coffee table, this set allows you to share relaxing moments in the shade or the sun. Its wood-effect steel frame ensures sturdiness and style, while the beige cushions, filled with polypropylene, offer plush comfort with their 10 cm thickness.
